records.public_claim_text: Urban rail Today, 54% of the world’s population lives in urban areas, but only one-tenth of that population lives in large cities with access to urban rail systems, most of which are in Europe and Asia.9 Partly as a consequence of this fact, metro and urban light rail account for less than 1% of motorised passenger-kilometres travelled worldwide.
